note: Terms the glossary maintainer must never auto-define. 'removed' are the ones a human deliberately took out (or never wants) — they must stay out even if they keep appearing in the issues. 'skipped' is filled automatically: acronyms the model judged not to be a certain institution/law/programme, kept here so they aren't re-queried every day. Clear an entry from 'skipped' to force a fresh look; keep 'removed' as the human veto.
